description: I scanned the eSIM QR code but it says the plan cannot be added. Not a big deal yet, but it's getting noticeable. Honestly it's a disgrace for what I pay.
agent_notes: Confirm the handset supports eSIM and is not carrier-locked using its IMEI.
Check that the QR code has not already been used and regenerate the eSIM profile if it has.
Ask the customer to connect to Wi-Fi and scan the new QR code from Settings.
Restart the phone after the profile downloads and confirm the line is active.
resolution_summary: eSIM profile regenerated after used QR code; activated over Wi-Fi.

description: i'm abroad and my phone has no data, is roaming not enabled? nothing i do seems to help and i'm getting exasperated. not a big deal yet, but it's getting noticeable. My account number is 48201937.
agent_notes: Verify international roaming is enabled on the line and the destination is covered by a roaming pass.
Ask the customer to enable data roaming on the handset and select the partner network manually.
Check usage records to see whether charges were outside the roaming pass.
Offer to activate a roaming pass for the rest of the trip.
resolution_summary: Roaming pass not active for destination; pass activated and goodwill credit given. Customer confirmed service restored.
